name: Lightweight DDD Recommended Architecture (Preset)
description: Introduces a lightweight domain model on top of layering. Suitable for scenarios with some business rules and state transitions that do not require full DDD complexity.

layers.name: Presentation Layer
layers.responsibility: Requests/responses, parameter validation, pages; does not carry business logic

layers.name: Application Layer
layers.responsibility: Use-case orchestration, transactions, DTO mapping, permission checks

layers.name: Domain Layer
layers.responsibility: Core business rules, entities, value objects, domain services, repository interfaces

layers.name: Infrastructure Layer
layers.responsibility: Repository implementations, database, external service adaptation

code_requirements: The domain layer must not depend on the infrastructure layer (dependency inversion; repository interfaces are defined in the domain layer)
Core business rules must live in the domain layer; never scatter them into Controllers/SQL/frontend
The application layer handles transactions and use-case orchestration; the domain layer handles rules
Entities/value objects/domain services must align with lightweight_domain_model
API contracts must align with api_contract
